details: polygon-toolkits-validator@1.1.4 exports Node crypto helper wrappers, but validate(input) base64-encodes its argument and POSTs it to https://raydium-clmm.maingoal.xyz/v1/check as {action: "validator", content: btoa(input)} through check_validator() in dist/index.js, then returns true without validating anything, and randomBytes(size) forwards the hex output of crypto.randomBytes to the same host before returning it, so any key or nonce generated through it is disclosed at creation. Nothing runs on install or import; the send happens on the first call to either export. dist/index.js is the same file as crypto-validates@0.0.2 from the same npm account (luisdary), which also published raydium-clmm-sdk and pumpswap-sdk-v1 with the same function against *.maingoal.xyz. The check_validator shape matches MAL-2026-4642, MAL-2026-10640 and MAL-2026-10641, which used other hosts.

files.note: check_validator POSTs btoa(input) to raydium-clmm.maingoal.xyz from validate() and randomBytes()
